summary: T5 ports the timeline graph painter and the mode preview card into src/ui2/timeline.rs and src/ui2/preview.rs, and the R2 round-2 rework is done: the preview clock's viewport gate now reads the clock widget's own rect instead of the card's, preview_card takes `clock_mounted` to reproduce the Iced view's Clock unmount while a profile dialog is open, and the monitor switch's advertised geometry is pinned by a shape-level regression test. 22 new tests over base; the full gate passes (181 egui-ui lib tests).

prior_commits.t5_initial: 92a6513 (graph painter, timeline card, preview card, clock, procedural glyphs)

base: b884b44 (agent/integration; agent/worker-1 was fast-forwarded to it before this task so the registered theme/timing modules compile -- see branch_sync)
branch_sync: `git merge --ff-only agent/integration` moved agent/worker-1 from 6348f22 to b884b44. T5's files are registered modules (src/ui2/mod.rs) and import super::theme, which is registered only on the integration base; the assignment named agent/integration as the integration base. The fast-forward authored no file contents -- it only received integration history. The T2 doc-fix commits (3d88f0c, 6348f22) were already merged into integration (8c95cd1).

review_references.R2_round_2: Round-2 review of agent/worker-1@3099f9b (report on agent/worker-1): FAIL with two low-severity findings, both fixed here -- (1a) the preview clock's visibility gate used the whole card rect instead of the clock widget's own rect (ui.md:144-145); (1b) the Iced Clock unmount while a profile dialog is open (src/ui/app.rs:1357-1363) was missing with no T7 handoff; (2) the monitor switch geometry from this report (48x24, radius 12, 20px knob, 2px padding) had no shape-level test. Evidence: `the_clock_stops_where_its_widget_leaves_the_viewport`, `an_unmounted_clock_emits_nothing`, `the_monitor_switch_paints_the_iced_toggler_geometry`.
review_references.R2_round_1: The round that produced the initial T5 dispatch: preview ownership, procedural transport glyphs (issue 7), and the 850 ms clock were the open items this task closed.

delivered_api.timeline::graph: pub fn graph(ui: &mut Ui, timeline: Option<&Timeline>, names: [&str; 4], language: Language, awake: bool) -> Response -- paints the whole canvas in one pass and publishes exactly one container-level node (WidgetType::Other -> accesskit Role::Unknown) labelled language.text("Key Input Timeline"). Display-only: no interactive node. Repaints every 16 ms only while awake and a span is held or the last release is inside the 1 s window (the Iced cadence).
delivered_api.timeline::timeline_section: pub fn timeline_section(ui: &mut Ui, monitor: &MonitorState, names: [&str; 4], language: Language, awake: bool, messages: &mut Vec<Message>) -> Response -- the Key Input Timeline card: header (Target mark + title + lifecycle subtitle) with the monitor switch, collapsed to that header while stopped; the graph mounts only while MonitorState::Recording, wrapped in theme::graph_frame(). The switch publishes Role::CheckBox with the selected/toggled state and the label Start timeline / Stop timeline / Starting… / Stopping…; a click pushes Message::ToggleMonitor. Geometry is the Iced toggler at .size(24): 48x24 pill, radius 12, padding round(0.1*24)=2, 20px knob 2px from either end (iced rev f8127c8 widget/src/toggler.rs), now pinned by the geometry test.
delivered_api.preview::preview_card: pub fn preview_card(ui: &mut Ui, timing: &TimingSettings, preview: &Preview, language: Language, awake: bool, clock_mounted: bool, messages: &mut Vec<Message>) -> Response -- the mode preview card: Previous / Play-Pause pill / Next, the A-D example keys, the game-view indicator, the delay badge (phase 1 highlight), the caption, the example dots, and the clock. The transport controls publish labelled button nodes (Previous example / Next example / Play preview / Pause preview); clicks push Message::Preview(Previous|Next|Toggle). The caption publishes a Label with the resolved "Game receives ..." text. R2 round 2: `clock_mounted` mirrors the Iced view's mount condition (the Clock widget was mounted only while the profile dialog was closed, src/ui/app.rs:1357-1363) -- false resets the deadline, emits no tick, and requests no frames; the clock's viewport gate reads the clock widget's own zero-height rect at the example column's last child, not the card's rect.
delivered_api.preview::PreviewClock: pub struct PreviewClock with pub fn poll(&mut self, now: f64, playing: bool, visible: bool, example: usize) -> bool and pub fn remaining(&self, now: f64) -> Option<f64> -- the 850 ms four-phase clock, stored in egui temp memory by preview_card. Pure timing rule so tests drive it with explicit times (Rule 8); ticks only while playing, awake, mounted, and its own widget rect is visible -- the Iced Clock widget's redraw-request rules.

integration_requirements_T7: src/ui2/timing.rs (T4's file, outside this task): timing_preview_section is now a duplicate. Replace its body/call site with preview::preview_card(ui, timing, &preview, language, awake, clock_mounted, messages). The mount currently takes `preview: Option<&Preview>` and no awake/clock flags; pass the app's real preview, the focus/awake signal, and `clock_mounted = matches!(state.profiles, ProfileDialog::Closed)` (src/ui2/state.rs:146 -- ProfileDialog does not derive PartialEq, so use matches!). The mount's font-glyph transport controls (⏴ ⏵ ⏸ ▶) are superseded and must be deleted with the mount body -- the new card draws them as paths.

src/ui2/app.rs (T7): mount timeline::timeline_section the way the Iced app mounted its timeline_section, with the four mapped names from the snapshot and the focus/awake signal. The Iced view returned nothing while no snapshot existed; keep that decision in the caller.

Accessible names: the graph container label is language.text("Key Input Timeline"); the switch labels use the existing language entries where they exist (Starting…, Stopping…) and fall back to the English source for Start timeline / Stop timeline, pending the localization policy.

tests.result: pass (no egui, eframe, wgpu, iced, or lyon)

tests_actually_executed_note: The scoped loop for the slice is `cargo test --no-default-features --features egui-ui --lib`: 159 passed before this change, 181 after (22 new: 11 timeline painter/card, 8 preview card/rule, 3 rework -- the two clock gates and the switch geometry). The clock tests assert repaint_delay (`Duration::MAX` means no frame request) and emitted messages; the switch test reads painted rect/circle shapes; the clock rule is a pure function driven with explicit times, never a sleep. Graph tests use `run_steps` because a live graph requests repaints by design, which would loop `run()` to its step cap.
unresolved_dependencies_for_master: Preview ownership: T5 has now implemented the real card in src/ui2/preview.rs; the old mount point in timing.rs is the duplicate to remove in the T7/integration wave (see integration_requirements_T7).

Font-weight strategy (carried, unchanged): graph block/ruler/keycap/badge/preview bold text uses theme::stamp_galley, the port's double-stamp approximation of the Iced UI_FONT_BOLD; registering a weighted face or recording the stamp stays the Master's open decision.
Accessible-name localization policy (carried): the new labels use language.text where a key exists; Start timeline / Stop timeline have no entry and render the English source.
Long-label hover-scroll (ui.md:146) remains unported and unscheduled (R1/R2 flagged it, not T5's mandate).
Native visual acceptance is still zero for these surfaces (docs/architecture/verification.md Unverified Areas); the new tests are shape- and node-level evidence only.
risks: T5 owns four private glyph painters (header Target mark, nav chevrons, Play/Stop, key arrows) because theme::Icon carries no transport or arrow glyphs. If a shared icon owner is created later, consolidate them (Rule 2). The transport set is the R2 round-1 issue 7 mandate for this task.
The graph's repaint cadence is the Iced 16 ms while animating; a deactivated window (awake=false) requests no frames, matching ui.md:25-29.
epaint strokes have no per-segment round caps, so the keycap arrows are drawn with the Iced coordinates but without the Iced LineCap::Round; at 1.4 px width the difference is sub-pixel.
The example-key pressed ring uses egui's Shadow blur (RectShape feathered edge) for the Iced keycap Pressed shadow; the keys' fill/border/ink are the Iced values.

The clock's unmount semantics are caller-driven: T7 must pass clock_mounted, or the dialog-open suppression silently regresses. The test pins the card side; the call-site binding is named in integration_requirements_T7.

timeline.rs previously had no data-model tests on disk; the five Iced timeline tests were ported here as part of the painter's contract, which is why the test delta is larger than the painter tests alone.
